claim_text: F3B establishes synthetic-ground-truth performance for the frozen AFINO 0.5 baseline within the prospectively specified simulation domain.
allowed_wording: Phase 3B characterizes synthetic-ground-truth performance of the frozen AFINO 0.5 baseline within the preregistered simulation domain.
mandatory_qualification: Always retain synthetic-domain scope.
prohibited_wording: AFINO is validated for real TESS populations.

claim_text: Independent HELDOUT sensitivity is 152/1800 = 0.08444444444444445.
allowed_wording: HELDOUT synthetic sensitivity was 152/1800 (0.08444).
mandatory_qualification: State denominator and synthetic HELDOUT scope.
prohibited_wording: Observational sensitivity is 8.44%.

claim_text: Independent HELDOUT specificity is 1800/1800 = 1.0 with finite-sample Wilson uncertainty.
allowed_wording: No false selections were observed among 1800 HELDOUT synthetic nulls; specificity point estimate was 1.0 with finite-sample Wilson uncertainty.
mandatory_qualification: Give denominator and Wilson interval; do not call it perfect.
prohibited_wording: Perfect specificity.

claim_text: No false selections were observed among 1800 HELDOUT synthetic nulls.
allowed_wording: Zero false selections were observed in 1800 synthetic null HELDOUT cases.
mandatory_qualification: Observed count only; not a population-rate theorem.
prohibited_wording: AFINO has an observational FPR of zero.

claim_text: Observed zero false selections does not imply population FPR = 0.
allowed_wording: The finite-sample result remains compatible with a nonzero underlying synthetic-domain FPR.
mandatory_qualification: Retain Wilson uncertainty and synthetic scope.
prohibited_wording: Population FPR is exactly zero.

claim_text: The DEVELOPMENT candidate rule was not promoted.
allowed_wording: The DEVELOPMENT candidate failed the preregistered specificity-preservation gate and was not promoted.
mandatory_qualification: Do not rescue a runner-up post hoc.
prohibited_wording: Choose another candidate after seeing HELDOUT.

claim_text: The final heldout rule remained the preregistered AFINO 0.5 baseline 10/10 rule.
allowed_wording: The final frozen rule was delta_BIC01 > 10 AND delta_BIC21 > 10 with strict greater-than comparisons.
mandatory_qualification: State candidate_rule_promoted=false.
prohibited_wording: The HELDOUT rule was optimized on HELDOUT.

claim_text: A validated correction was not established.
allowed_wording: Phase 3B did not establish a validated observational correction.
mandatory_qualification: Keep NOT_ESTABLISHED explicit.
prohibited_wording: Phase 3B provides a validated population correction.

claim_text: The synthetic selection function was characterized on an independent single-use HELDOUT.
allowed_wording: The final synthetic selection function is the 156-row independent HELDOUT stratified empirical surface.
mandatory_qualification: No DEVELOPMENT pooling or smoothing.
prohibited_wording: The final selection function pools DEVELOPMENT and HELDOUT.

claim_text: The selection function is domain-conditional and is not an observational population correction without transport assumptions.
allowed_wording: The HELDOUT surface is conditional on the frozen synthetic design and requires additional transport assumptions before observational use.
mandatory_qualification: Do not transport directly to real TESS populations.
prohibited_wording: This is the observational TESS selection function.

claim_text: Period estimates among selected true positives were accurate relative to the much lower selection coverage.
allowed_wording: Conditional period-recovery accuracy can be summarized for selected true positives while overall selection coverage remains low.
mandatory_qualification: Period-error summaries are conditional on selection.
prohibited_wording: Good period recovery implies high QPP sensitivity.

claim_text: Period accuracy conditional on selection does not imply high QPP recovery sensitivity.
allowed_wording: Accurate periods among selected true positives coexist with low overall synthetic QPP selection sensitivity.
mandatory_qualification: Keep conditioning explicit.
prohibited_wording: Period accuracy demonstrates high detection completeness.

claim_text: Numerical classification stability on the frozen DEVELOPMENT seed subset does not establish a unique numerical optimum.
allowed_wording: The DEVELOPMENT stability exercise is a bounded numerical diagnostic and does not establish optimizer uniqueness.
mandatory_qualification: Do not overstate seed-stability evidence.
prohibited_wording: The optimizer has a unique global optimum.

claim_text: Input inadmissibility remains a separate pipeline plane.
allowed_wording: Input admissibility and classifier performance remain separate analysis planes.
mandatory_qualification: Do not recode challenge series as FN/TN.
prohibited_wording: Input-inadmissible challenges are classifier false negatives.

claim_text: F3B does not establish real-TESS QPP prevalence.
allowed_wording: Real-TESS QPP prevalence remains outside Phase 3B.
mandatory_qualification: Requires observational population modeling and transport assumptions.
prohibited_wording: Phase 3B measures real-TESS QPP prevalence.

claim_text: F3B does not establish observational PPV, sensitivity, specificity or FPR.
allowed_wording: Reported operating characteristics are synthetic-domain quantities.
mandatory_qualification: Observational performance requires later validation/transport.
prohibited_wording: These are observational sensitivity, specificity, PPV or FPR.

claim_text: F3B does not establish physical QPP truth for observational events.
allowed_wording: Synthetic labels provide controlled truth only for the simulation experiment.
mandatory_qualification: Physical truth in observed stars is separate.
prohibited_wording: F3B proves an observational event physically contains a QPP.

claim_text: AFINO has not been observationally validated by F3B.
allowed_wording: Use scoped synthetic-ground-truth characterization language.
mandatory_qualification: Any validation language must specify evidence plane.
prohibited_wording: AFINO is observationally validated.

claim_text: The HELDOUT is consumed and cannot be reused for further threshold/rule development.
allowed_wording: The single-use HELDOUT is closed to further rule development.
mandatory_qualification: Future tuning requires new independent data/design.
prohibited_wording: Reuse HELDOUT to tune another threshold.

claim_text: Manuscript 1's synthetic-validation component is now complete.
allowed_wording: The synthetic-ground-truth validation component required for Manuscript 1 is complete.
mandatory_qualification: Do not collapse other evidence planes into this statement.
prohibited_wording: All observational validation is complete.

claim_text: Manuscript 1 must not claim a validated correction.
allowed_wording: Manuscript 1 may report the synthetic selection function but must state that a validated observational correction was not established.
mandatory_qualification: Keep correction claim NOT_ESTABLISHED.
prohibited_wording: A validated correction has been established.

claim_text: Population-level correction/transport remains a later F4+ problem.
allowed_wording: Population transport and observational correction remain future work beyond Phase 3B.
mandatory_qualification: Requires explicit transport assumptions and later evidence.
prohibited_wording: Apply the synthetic HELDOUT surface directly as a population correction.
